Offer and Login FAQ
blocks.summary: 6 short questions and answers on the login and the account.
blocks.notes: A bulleted list of 6 items in the form "- **Question?** Answer." (bold question, then a one-sentence answer); bold is required here for the question text only. Questions, in this order: (1) when the welcome bonus can be claimed (after registration, on the first qualifying deposit of at least €50); (2) how to log in (with the registered e-mail and password, as the page explains); (3) how fast a withdrawal request is processed (generally within three working days; do not promise a payout time); (4) how long verification takes (a complete document set is normally reviewed within up to 10 days); (5) whether there is a VIP programme (yes, with five tiers: Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum and Diamond); (6) where to turn when the login still fails (customer support: live chat 24/7 or e-mail; do not print the e-mail address). Answers repeat the facts of the sections of the page in other words and add nothing new. Do not answer questions about multiple devices, lockouts or login limits: no data.
